rule: Knockback: a hit pushes an enemy with speed = 40 times damage squared over (weight + 10 times damage) in classic units (algebraically equal to the float code, whose factor of 256 cancels), converted to unity units by dividing by 3.95, with a minimum of 15 classic units. The enemy motor caps the stored speed at 40 classic units, moves at up to 25, enters the hurt pose above 5, re-evaluates its tactic above 10, and decays the stored speed by 5 classic units per classic tick (1/16 s). A hit does not re-push an enemy that is already sliding above 5 (intended; one site violates it, see defects). Status: each effect is a magic-round countdown; one round is one in-game minute; catch-up is capped at 2880 rounds. A like-kind incumbent on a host absorbs later applications: paralysis and silence add rounds, drain adds magnitude, fortify keeps one magnitude and adds rounds only. Poison is a state machine with a start delay and a duration drawn per poison type, ticking once per game minute, not stacking with itself. Chance and saving throw are checked after the effect starts (so a rejected cast can still extend an incumbent; see defects).

keep: Push speed scales with damage squared over (weight + 10 times damage): heavy hits on light creatures slide far, heavy creatures barely move.
Minimum push, a store cap, a motion cap and a per-tick decay: the slide has a readable arc and a clear stop.
No re-push while already sliding above the threshold: the crowd cannot chain-launch one enemy.
One magic round is one game minute with a catch-up cap; the rounds count is the duration.
Like-kind incumbent per host: later applications add rounds or magnitude to the one live status.
Poison's start delay is a readable quiet window before the first tick.
Silence blocks casting and paralysis stops movement; both print one HUD line when they land.
change: Fix the chance and save ordering so a rejected cast cannot extend an incumbent.
Parenthesise the no-re-push gate and use one knockback function for every path.
Drop the legacy 256 factor and use 40 times damage squared over (weight + 10 times damage).
Clamp weight to at least 1 before dividing.
Server seeds the poison start delay and duration (donor uses Unity Random); write the draw to the fight record.
Decide fortify: keep refresh-only (recast adds rounds, not magnitude) or let a stronger recast raise the magnitude.
Round the game-minute clock to server ticks; keep the catch-up cap as a fixed limit in zone data.
look_test: Pit dummy in two sizes with three buttons. Heavy hit on light dummy: long slide with clear stop. Heavy hit on heavy dummy: short nudge. Two hits in quick succession on a weighted non-enemy-class dummy: second hit must NOT restart the slide (fails today). Paralysis cast three times: remaining duration grows each time. Paralysis forced to fail its chance: remaining duration must NOT grow (fails today). Judge on a 375-wide screen.
